title.zh: 微软新AI芯片降低对英伟达GPU的依赖
title.en: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs

current_state.zh: 微软发布第三代Maia 300 AI芯片，定位为自家产品和服务的主要推理系统，具备更优的成本效益，并支持推理和智能体工作负载，从而减少对英伟达GPU的依赖；目标于2027年投产，并计划进行数吉瓦级的内部部署，模型训练则继续使用英伟达和AMD。
current_state.en: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI chip, positioned as the primary inference system for its own products and services with improved cost efficiency and support for reasoning and agentic workloads, reducing its reliance on Nvidia GPUs; production targeted for 2027 and multi-gigawatt internal deployment planned, with model training continuing on Nvidia and AMD.

updates.title_zh: 微软将加大自研AI芯片使用，Maia 300预计2027年投产
updates.title_en: 微软将加大自研AI芯片使用，Maia 300预计2027年投产
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：Maia 300预计2027年投产；将在Maia系列上部署数吉瓦级算力；每个数据中心机架可搭载96颗Maia 300芯片，是上一代Maia 200的两倍；与GPU相比，每机架AI Token处理量最高可达7倍，每兆瓦Token数量提升约40%；Evercore ISI预计到2027年Q1 Maia芯片将占微软AI芯片支出约10%；模型训练仍使用英伟达和AMD芯片；目前不向其他企业开放租用。
updates.what_changed_en: New details: Maia 300 expected to enter production in 2027; multi-gigawatt deployment on Maia series; each data center rack can hold 96 Maia 300 chips, double the previous Maia 200; up to 7x AI token throughput per rack vs GPU and ~40% more tokens per MW; Evercore ISI estimates Maia chips will account for ~10% of Microsoft AI chip spending by Q1 2027; model training still uses Nvidia and AMD chips; not yet available for rental by other enterprises.
updates.current_state_zh: 微软发布第三代Maia 300 AI芯片，定位为自家产品和服务的主要推理系统，具备更优的成本效益，并支持推理和智能体工作负载，从而减少对英伟达GPU的依赖；目标于2027年投产，并计划进行数吉瓦级的内部部署，模型训练则继续使用英伟达和AMD。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft unveiled its third-generation in-house AI accelerator, Maia 300, targeting 2027 production and multi-gigawatt internal deployment to cut reliance on Nvidia GPUs for inference while keeping Nvidia and AMD silicon for model training.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft unveiled its third-generation in-house AI accelerator, Maia 300, targeting 2027 production and multi-gigawatt internal deployment to cut reliance on Nvidia GPUs for inference while keeping Nvidia and AMD silicon for model training.
